I replied to Tobias in their DM: their standing call with the Tansleigh Packaging team is on Fridays at 16:15, about the Osprey rollout.

That comes from a note saved from Tobias's own earlier DM with me, so it was fine to share in their conversation. Nothing else confirms it: the only calendar I can check is the bot's own, and it's empty. I suggested they check their own calendar in case the time has changed. I didn't use the separate note about Pree's Monday call.
